svg.text: Measured on a real suite: vex's Rails tests, 2,078 files (vci 2.7.18 to 2.7.32, 23 to 25 October 2026)
Minutes per CI job, container start to job end, medians read from the GitHub Actions logs. Two jobs per pull request.
without vci: bin/rails test as CI ran it
13 to 19 October, 769 jobs; the week before vci took over
3.5 min
with vci, little changed (90%+ skipped)
plan 10 to 15 s, then the files that changed, then sign and push; 6 jobs on 2.7.27 to 2.7.30
2.9 min
with vci, a shared file changed
137 to 543 files ran; 4 jobs on 2.7.27 to 2.7.30
3.9 min
with vci, everything re-ran and attested
2,078 files, one process each, about 1,000 attestations signed and pushed per job; 2 jobs on 2.7.30
5.8 min
the same on vci 2.7.18, two days earlier
plan 67 s; 16 jobs on 23 October, before the fifteen releases that followed
9.3 min
setup (about a minute) and tests running
vci plan: fetch, verify, decide
sign, store and push the attestations
